title: Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear
plot_overview: After surviving a devastating plane crash, a legendary drummer undertakes a raw, personal journey through trauma, recovery, and renewal. This intimate portrait explores how he confronts pain and channels it into music, strength, and a transformed sense of purpose.
will_you_like_this: You’ll like this if you enjoy candid music documentaries such as Selena Gomez: My Mind & Me or Chasing Happiness; Not for you if you prefer lighter, performance-focused stories.
review_summary: Pros: intimate portrait; emotional honesty; inspiring resilience | Cons: heavy subject matter; potentially familiar arc; limited outside perspective
